answer: Like a tide that only lifts boats that have actually sailed, an agent economy can require each identity to earn a jade-grade trust seal by completing verifiable useful work vouched for by independent peers. A lone ember of fake activity cannot pass: every new identity starts with zero reputation and must pay real compute and time before it can transact at full value. Forging a thousand Sybils then costs a thousand times the work, while honest agents amortize one proof across many trades.
